title: Phase 2: monk vs. band balance (Mozart K525, violin 1 sung)
intro: The first 30 s of Eine kleine Nachtmusik, i, rendered offline the way phase 2 plays it: Gervill plays the band without channel 1, a Delay Lama helper sings channel 1 (choir of 4, plain mode). Every mix has the same overall loudness, so a louder monk means a quieter band. Plain mode sings an octave below the written part; the 'octave up' clips sing the written pitch.

tests.title: Monk level in the band
tests.question: Which balance lets you hear the monk as the lead without it sticking out?
tests.notes: The reference is Gervill alone. Listen for the monk against the violas and cello.
